unlisted_practices: Carry out quality assessment of data-driven algorithm studies with two independent reviewers and reach consensus on interpretation of criteria prior to scoring.
Partition data into train and test sets at the participant level, at the beginning of the data pipeline, to prevent data leakage.
Evaluate algorithms with both internal (unseen test set) and external validation (newly sampled data).
Report complementary performance metrics covering significance, uncertainty, discrimination and calibration.
Report all results, including algorithm subtypes and subgroups, to avoid selective reporting.
Apply correction for multiple testing where applicable and provide measures of significance or uncertainty.
Use quality assessment tools that address the full data pipeline to guide standardised and reproducible development of data-driven healthcare algorithms.
Use quality assessment tools like DATA-CARE to inform regulatory guidelines (e.g., MDR) for standardised and reproducible algorithm development.

screen.reason: Development and validation of an assessment framework/tool (DATA-CARE) for critical appraisal and quality evaluation of data pipelines in AI algorithms.
